Figure 3 from p at this link https://aucklandcouncil.resolve.red/portal/Meeting/13534/93061?type=1&docId=30289

Supply deficits for aquatic facilities if no further investment, expressed in standard equivalent facilities

Maps of Auckland region at 2032, 2042 and 2052, with legend.  

Shows gaps in coloured circles, darker for worse gaps.  

Gaps exist for 2032 in Hisbiscus, North Shore, North West, West, Whau, Flat Bush, Mid South, Deep South.  Worst is West.  

Gaps for 2042 adds additional circle for Mid South East, gaps for North West, West, Whau and Mid South worsen.

Gaps for 2052 adds additional circle for Warkworth, gaps for North Shore, Whau, Flat Bush, Mid South East all worsen (further in some cases).
